# Traffic Down and Latency Up at S-SFX-003

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-SFX-02-B`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of a major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on the shared microwave link matching the timing of the KPI onset, with changes, maintenance, and external events checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-09 12:45 to 2026-09-09 16:40
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-09 12:36
- **Affected:** S-SFX-003, S-SFX-001

## Summary

A major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-B caused transport degradation affecting downstream sites S-SFX-003 and S-SFX-001.

Traffic was down and latency was up at S-SFX-003 and S-SFX-001 between 2026-09-09 12:45 and 2026-09-09 16:40.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-09 12:36: Major LINK_DEGRADED alarm raised on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-B. [ALM-000165, RB-MICROWAVE-DEGRADATION#02]
- 2026-09-09 12:45: Earliest KPI onset: S-SFX-003 download volume dropped and latency spiked. [T7, ANM-000139, ANM-000140, ALR-0008]
- 2026-09-09 16:40: LINK_DEGRADED alarm cleared on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-B, ending the impact. [ALM-000165]

## Evidence

- A detector alert overlapped from 2026-09-09 10:00 to 2026-09-10 08:14 on entity S-SFX-003. [T1]
- S-SFX-003 depends on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-B, aggregator AGG-SFX-02, and core CORE-UPF-02. [T2]
- A major LINK_DEGRADED alarm was active on LNK-SFX-02-B from 2026-09-09 12:36 to 2026-09-09 16:40. [T3, T6, ALM-000165]
- No changes occurred on S-SFX-003, LNK-SFX-02-B, AGG-SFX-02 or its parents between 2026-09-09 11:00 and 2026-09-09 19:00. [T4]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on S-SFX-003, LNK-SFX-02-B, AGG-SFX-02 or its parents between 2026-09-09 11:00 and 2026-09-09 19:00. [T5]
- KPI deviation showed S-SFX-003 download volume below baseline and latency spiked starting at 2026-09-09 12:45. [T7, ANM-000139, ANM-000140]
- No external events occurred for region SFX between 2026-09-09 11:00 and 2026-09-09 19:00. [T9]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SFX-02-B: confirmed. Major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on LNK-SFX-02-B directly matches the timeline and KPI degradation on downstream sites S-SFX-003 and S-SFX-001, with no conflicting changes or maintenance. [ALM-000165, RB-MICROWAVE-DEGRADATION#02, RB-MICROWAVE-DEGRADATION#05]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were found on the nodes or parents during the relevant window. [T4]
3. **planned_maintenance**: rejected. No maintenance windows were scheduled during the relevant window. [T5]

- ALM-000166: Mains failure on S-SFX-004 occurred later and on a different site, unrelated to S-SFX-003 transport issues.

- ALM-000168: Site down on S-SFX-004 occurred later and on a different site, unrelated to S-SFX-003 transport issues.

- Inspect microwave link LNK-SFX-02-B for environmental interference, hardware errors, or physical obstruction that caused the temporary degradation.
